summary: Architectural implementation plan for the Universal STEM Agentic Faculty & University Discovery Engine. Expands coverage across all fields of Science, Technology, and Engineering (Biomedical, Chemistry, Physics, Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, Aerospace, Materials, and Computing). Implements an autonomous multi-agent pipeline querying the OpenAlex scholarly graph and global academic directories, coupled with an empirical CV-readiness calibration engine and a 4-gate QA/QC verification protocol before presenting any verified faculty matches to the researcher.
